candidates.title: Transfer mobile game test logs to a sheet

ease.reason: A fictional CSV-to-row mock is approachable; no supplied source documents n8n trigger or file handling.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: mobile game QA contractors may value easier session logs; this single post establishes no buyer intent or payment.

feasibility.reason: A four-week mock can map supplied log rows into a sheet-shaped table; phone uploads, parsing and trigger reliability remain unverified.

autonomy.reason: A proposed import can repeat on supplied files, but a person must confirm completeness and resolve duplicates; live intake is unsupported.

evidence.reason: The retained spans give the logged fields, manual CSV transfer and trigger/double-fire problem; recurrence beyond the author is unknown.

candidates.reason: Concrete chore evaluated as a proposed synthetic CSV mapping experiment. Provisional scores are below threshold; no implementation reference supports the live phone, trigger or Sheets loop.

experimentPlan.output: A reviewable table of supplied game-test log entries, with duplicate rows flagged.
inputs: Fictional CSV rows with battery, temperature, frame drops and session note
experimentPlan.trigger: An operator selects a completed sample CSV for a mock import.
steps: Map the listed fields into a proposed sheet-shaped table.
Flag repeated rows using a proposed row key.
Compare the output with operator-supplied expected rows.
Show uncertain or malformed rows for human review.
experimentPlan.acceptanceCheck: For a small fictional CSV, every valid input row appears once with its four listed fields, and intentionally repeated rows are flagged.
experimentPlan.humanBoundary: The operator supplies fictional or authorized test logs, chooses the duplicate rule, and reviews all flagged or missing rows before using any real data.
unverified: Whether a phone can reliably upload a completed file
Whether the CSV has a stable format
Whether a chosen key can distinguish duplicates
n8n trigger and Google Sheets execution are not supported by supplied implementation evidence

demandEvidence.chore: Record mobile-game battery, temperature, frame drops and a short session note, then transfer the log into a Google Sheet.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: Right now I type it into a notes app during the session, then later export a CSV from that app and paste it into a Google Sheet.

candidates.title: Prepare a weekly keyword metrics sheet

ease.reason: A manual-input report mock is possible, but the source documents an Apify Actor workflow rather than supplied build instructions.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: marketing consultants may pay for prepared keyword metrics; a maker post and usage price do not establish buyers for this proposed service.

feasibility.reason: A four-week mock can format operator-provided keyword metrics; actor access, fresh results and scheduled execution are unverified.

autonomy.reason: The described existing flow runs weekly, but no supplied building reference supports recreating it; a person must provide inputs and verify figures.

evidence.reason: The post specifies weekly search-volume, CPC and difficulty rows in Sheets, but is a maker demonstration without corroborated market demand.

candidates.reason: The post describes a specific weekly metrics workflow, so it is assessed as a narrow report-formatting proposal. The maker demonstration is not verified buyer demand; the provisional mean is below threshold.

experimentPlan.output: A reviewable spreadsheet-shaped report for operator-supplied keyword metrics.
inputs: Operator-supplied volume, CPC and difficulty values
experimentPlan.trigger: The operator provides a small sample of keyword metrics for weekly report preparation.
steps: Check that each row has volume, CPC and difficulty fields.
Place the supplied values into a consistent table.
Mark missing values without filling them in.
Compare the table with the supplied source rows.
experimentPlan.acceptanceCheck: Every supplied keyword appears once with unchanged values; missing fields are marked and no value is inferred.
experimentPlan.humanBoundary: The operator obtains and supplies the metrics, verifies their freshness and approves any report sent to a client.
unverified: Whether marketing consultants want or would pay for this separate service

demandEvidence.chore: Run a weekly keyword-volume lookup and add search volume, CPC and difficulty to a Google Sheet.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: Runs VNCNT Labs’ Keyword Search Volume Actor on Apify every week and adds each keyword’s Google search volume, CPC and difficulty as rows in Google Sheets.
